events.title: Nokia Lumia 920 released
events.summary: Nokia released the Nokia Lumia 920 — wireless charging and PureView camera on Windows Phone 8.
events.about: Nokia hardware shaped pre-iPhone smartphones and later Microsoft's mobile platform bet. Wireless charging and pureview camera on windows phone 8.

narrative.whyChosen: The Nokia Lumia 920 was a flagship Nokia smartphone milestone.
narrative.whyImportant: Nokia devices defined mobile platforms from Symbian through Windows Phone.
narrative.problemSolved: Mobile users needed capable smartphones before the iPhone/Android era matured.

events.title: Nexus 4 released
events.summary: Google began selling the Nexus 4 — LG-built affordable flagship with wireless charging.
events.about: Nexus and Pixel phones were Google's pure-Android reference hardware for developers. Lg-built affordable flagship with wireless charging. AOSP builds and CTS testing often used Pixel devices as the baseline.

narrative.whyChosen: The Nexus 4 was a flagship Google Android reference device.
narrative.whyImportant: Pixel/Nexus hardware defines the reference Android experience for developers.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed first-party reference phones without OEM skin fragmentation.
